examples.name: Unread notification count
examples.description: Badge with a text alternative for an otherwise ambiguous value: screen readers read the label, as hidden text, in place of the number.

examples.name: Positive delta
examples.description: Success tone for a positive score or count change.

examples.name: Negative delta
examples.description: Error tone for a negative score or count change.

antiExamples.name: Long label
antiExamples.reason: Badge is for compact numeric values, not long labels.

antiExamples.name: Interactive badge
antiExamples.reason: Badge is non-interactive: it isn't focusable and has no button role, so a click handler on it can't be reached by keyboard. Use Button or Icon Button.

antiExamples.name: Status text
antiExamples.reason: Use Tag or Label for status/classification text.

antiExamples.name: aria-label on the badge
antiExamples.reason: The span has no role, so screen readers may ignore aria-label. Use label, which Badge renders as hidden text.
